CHAPTER.VERS: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,
Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;

Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
men: Heb. children
And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I the LORD.

For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped
hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;
hands: Heb. hand
feet: Heb. foot
heart: Heb. soul

Behold, therefore I will stretch out my hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I the LORD.
a spoil: or, meat

Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,
side…: Heb. shoulder of Moab

To the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
with…: or, against the children of Ammon
And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I the LORD.

Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
by…: Heb. by revenging revengement

Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out my hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
they…: or, they shall fall by the sword unto Dedan
And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to my anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.

Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy for the old hatred;
for the…: or, with perpetual hatred

Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
sea coast: or, haven of the sea

And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
great vengeance: Heb. great vengeances
